judge.rationale: The implementation is a textbook realization of the Zero-Trust Audit Principle ZT-2. It computes the decision first, unconditionally appends the log record containing all three required fields (role, permission, allowed) before returning, and then returns the result — guaranteeing no code path can bypass the audit write. The deny-by-default behavior is achieved cleanly via `matrix.get(role, set())`. The code is flat, explicit, readable, and contains zero architectural slop: no classes, no decorators, no hidden state, no short-circuit returns, and no unnecessary abstraction layers.
